title: CLI & Linux Intro
task: Read docs/welcome.txt and save its contents as welcome-copy.txt in the workspace root. Save a one-name-per-line listing of docs to docs-list.txt in the workspace root. Sort the listing by name, without directory prefixes.
hints: Use pwd to verify you are in the lab and ls docs to learn the file names.
cat reads the welcome file and > directs its stdout to the report.
Use LC_ALL=C ls -1 docs > docs-list.txt for a repeatable listing.

checks.label: The welcome note was copied intact
checks.feedback: Use cat on docs/welcome.txt and send stdout to welcome-copy.txt.

checks.label: The docs listing has one sorted name per line
checks.feedback: Use ls -1 docs with no path prefixes and write docs-list.txt.

demo.explanation: The path is where a new relative file name starts.
The first cat writes to the report through >. The second reads the report back.
